structure.unit: Taxes Administered by the Department of Taxation
Virginia Aircraft Sales and Use Tax

law.catch_line: Retention of documents; examination by Commissioner
law.text: Any person who sells, leases or charters an aircraft in this Commonwealth shall retain a copy of the invoice and other financial data pertaining to the transaction required by § 58.1-1503 for three years following such transaction. Each invoice shall give an accurate description of the aircraft sold, leased or used.
